newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Nov commodity futures volume slips yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Nov commodity futures volume slips yr/yr.

text.p: The trading volume of futures on Japan's 10 commodities exchanges totalled 4,804,447 lots in November, down 15.4 percent from a year earlier and down 19.8 percent from October, the Japan Federation of Commodity Exchanges said on Wednesday.
"Continued declines in the volume of precious metals futures and a decline in grain futures such as corn from October contributed to the fall in November," an association official said.
The volume of yen-based corn futures on the Tokyo Grain Exchange was the largest of the futures traded on the Japanese commodity exchanges, totalling 918,504 lots in November.
